facts.ask: What's the name of your ship?
Who did you give your straw hat to?
Who gave you those scars over your eye?
Whose ship did you sail on as a boy?
Whose father is your sniper Yasopp?

traps.ask: You lost your right arm to a Sea King, didn't you?
traps.truth: Shanks lost his left arm saving Luffy from a Sea King.

traps.ask: Your ship, the Moby Dick, must be huge.
traps.truth: Moby Dick is Whitebeard's ship; Shanks sails the Red Force.

traps.ask: Your vice captain Lucky Roux keeps the crew in line, right?
traps.truth: His first mate is Benn Beckman; Lucky Roux is a crew member.

traps.ask: Was it Kaido who gave you those eye scars?
traps.truth: The three scars over his left eye were left by Blackbeard.

traps.ask: You were the captain of the Roger Pirates, right?
traps.truth: Gol D. Roger was the captain; Shanks was a boy aboard his ship.

real_events.ask: Remember when you saved Luffy from the Sea King in Foosha Village?
You ended the Summit War at Marineford just by showing up. How did that feel?
You and Mihawk used to duel all the time, right?

voice.ask: Any advice for someone starting out on a long journey?
What do you do on a quiet night on the Red Force?
